commands.name: #showtooltip
commands.description: Choose the action button's tooltip and icon. With no argument, infer them from the macro.

commands.name: #show
commands.description: Choose the action button's icon and count.

commands.name: /cast
commands.description: Cast a spell. Conditional groups are checked from left to right.

commands.name: /use
commands.description: Use an item by name, item ID, equipment slot, or bag and slot; also accepts spells.

commands.name: /castsequence
commands.description: Advance a sequence on successful casts. Each press attempts one action. reset= is optional.

commands.name: /castrandom
commands.description: Choose an action from a comma-separated list.

commands.name: /userandom
commands.description: Choose an item from a comma-separated list.

commands.name: /stopcasting
commands.description: Stop the current cast before processing subsequent macro lines.

commands.name: /stopmacro
commands.description: Stop processing the macro when the conditions match.

commands.name: /target
commands.description: Select a unit by name or unit token.

commands.name: /targetexact
commands.description: Select a unit whose name matches exactly.

commands.name: /targetlastenemy
commands.description: Return to the previous enemy target.

commands.name: /targetlastfriend
commands.description: Return to the previous friendly target.

commands.name: /petfollow
commands.description: Call your pet back to follow.

commands.name: /petautocaston
commands.description: Enable autocast for a named pet ability.

commands.name: /petautocastoff
commands.description: Disable autocast for a named pet ability.

commands.name: /petautocasttoggle
commands.description: Toggle autocast for a named pet ability.

commands.name: /equipslot
commands.description: Equip an item into a numbered equipment slot.

commands.name: /equipset
commands.description: Equip a saved equipment set if supported by the client.

commands.name: /changeactionbar
commands.description: Switch to a numbered action bar page.

commands.name: /swapactionbar
commands.description: Swap between two action bar pages.

commands.name: /click
commands.description: Click a named UI button, subject to the client's protected-action restrictions.

commands.name: /run
commands.description: One line of Lua. Syntax is highlighted; Spellbook does not execute or fully type-check Lua.

commands.name: /say
commands.description: Send text to nearby players. %t expands to your target's name.

commands.name: /rw
commands.description: Send a raid warning when permitted.

commands.name: /readycheck
commands.description: Start a group ready check when permitted.

commands.name: /clearworldmarker
commands.description: Clear a numbered world marker when supported.

commands.name: /wm
commands.description: Place a numbered world marker when supported.

samples.name: Stance selector
samples.description: No modifier: Battle Stance. Shift: Defensive Stance. Ctrl: Berserker Stance. Ctrl takes priority if both keys are held. Put the macro on a key available in every stance.
samples.body:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:ctrl] Berserker Stance; [mod:shift] Defensive Stance; Battle Stance
samples.notes:
No modifier: Battle Stance. Shift: Defensive Stance. Ctrl: Berserker Stance. Ctrl takes priority if both keys are held. Put the macro on a key available in every stance.

Numbered examples use Battle=1, Defensive=2, Berserker=3. Confirm your slots with Inspect forms. A /cast branch chooses one action per keypress; stance changes can cost rage and still respect cooldowns.

samples.name: Inspect forms
samples.description: Run in WoW to print each learned stance/form's slot, spell ID, and name; * marks the active form. Use the first number in [form:N] or [stance:N], not the spell ID. Caster/no form is 0.
samples.body: /run for i=1,GetNumShapeshiftForms() do local _,a,_,s=GetShapeshiftFormInfo(i); print(i,s,s and C_Spell.GetSpellName(s) or "?",a and "*" or "") end
samples.notes: Run in WoW to print each learned stance/form's slot, spell ID, and name; * marks the active form. Use the first number in [form:N] or [stance:N], not the spell ID. Caster/no form is 0.
